analysis.title: The Gold Standard: Market Review – November 20
key_insights: Broad risk-off week: S&P 500 fell 8.6% to 6,910, Nasdaq Composite fell 10.0%, and the VIX rose to 35.9 from 16.6 a week earlier.
Gold fell 8.9% on the week to $3,538/oz, down 21.7% over 3 months and 18.1% YTD. Physical gold ETFs saw outflows of 284koz and global holdings were 100.7Moz.
Silver fell 15.6% to $41.16/oz, platinum fell 12.8% and palladium fell 11.0%. Silver ETFs saw outflows of 4Moz.
Gold equities underperformed bullion. GDX fell 16.2%, GDXJ fell 17.9% and the XAU index fell 16.8%, with 3-month declines of 31.5% for GDX and 37.1% for GDXJ.
Despite the selloff, gold equity ETFs took in $378m of inflows in the week and silver equity ETFs saw $98m of outflows.
CFTC net long gold fell 24k to 157k contracts, down 62k over 3 months. Net long silver fell 1k to 15k contracts.

Rates: 10Y yield fell 19bps to 4.95%, with real yields down 11bps to 2.78% and breakevens down 8bps to 2.17%. The 2s10s spread narrowed 2bps to 0.29%. Gold fell despite lower real yields, consistent with a liquidation move.
The dollar strengthened. DXY rose 0.4% to 103.9. ZAR weakened 3.8% and MXN 3.4%. Gold in USD fell more than gold in EUR, GBP or AUD.
Industrial commodities sold off: Comex copper fell 9.9% to $5.57/lb, WTI fell 5.2% to $83.98/bbl and Brent fell 3.6% to $92.43/bbl.
Bitcoin fell 8.5% on the week to about $59k, down 30.4% over 1 month and 32.8% YTD.
Credit spreads widened: HY OAS rose 28bps to 344bps and IG OAS rose 6bps to 92bps in the performance table. A chart annotation lists HY 392bps and IG 132bps.
Worst weekly gold equity moves versus the index: Seabridge Gold (-30.2%), Coeur Mining (-23.6%), Sinda (-23.2%), Eldorado Gold (-21.6%), I-80 Gold (-21.2%).
Short interest rose at Hycroft, Novagold, Fortuna, I-80 Gold and Eldorado Gold and fell at Perpetua. Short interest data is as of Oct 30, so it predates this week's selloff.
S&P 500 sectors all fell. Tech was worst at -12.2%, telecom -9.4%, materials -7.9%, and staples were best at -2.0%.
Gold to silver ratio is 86x vs a 10-year average of 81x. Gold to copper is 642x vs 544x, gold to oil is 42x vs 33x.

macro_indicators.interpretation: Yields fell 19bps in a risk-off week.
Real yields fell 11bps, yet gold still dropped sharply.
Chart annotation, with PPI 6.5% and import prices 9.2% YoY.

crypto_views: Bitcoin fell 8.5% on the week to $59,013, down 30.4% over 1 month, 18.9% over 3 months and 32.8% YTD.
risk_factors: Cross-asset liquidation: equities, metals, crypto and credit all sold off together.
Stronger dollar and rising credit spreads could add pressure to metals.
Short interest data predates the selloff, so current positioning may differ.
